Click Connect on the Gmail card and sign in with Google.
Go back to the chat and type: Find my emails from a sender you know.
Compare the listed messages with the sender and subject shown in Gmail.

Compare the full body in the chat with the body in Gmail.

S56.03.note: Gmail OAuth client is not yet set up on the owner side per the plan.
